item.title: Green GSM introduces its premium 7-seater black taxis in Metro Manila
item.description: If you commute around Metro Manila, there are many ways to go from point A to point B. Whether taking jeepneys, buses, trains, motorcycle taxis, TNVS, or other regular cabs, there’s no doubt that Green GSM is one of the cheapest four-wheeled ride-hailing services we’ve tried so far.
